# SafeSteps

> Calm, kind AI health guidance assistant helping users understand symptoms and make informed decisions on care urgency.

## Overview
SafeSteps is a clinical-grade health guidance and triage assistant built for educational triage, laboratory report comprehension, and doctor visit preparation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Symptom Triage**: Structured symptom assessment mapping to self-care, doctor-visit, or emergency care.
- **Emergency Detection**: Instant redirection for high-acuity red flags (chest pain, stroke signs, severe hemorrhage, respiratory failure).
- **Clinical Knowledge Retrieval**: Grounded medical guidance citing verified public health guidelines.
- **Laboratory Report Explanations**: Plain-language patient explanations for blood tests and pathology markers.
- **Doctor Visit Summary**: Printable and downloadable A4 PDF visit briefs.
- **Privacy & Safety**: Compliant with India DPDP Act 2023; transient report parsing and right to data erasure.
- **Multilingual Support**: Available in English, Tamil (தமிழ்), and Hindi (हिन्दी).

## Key Links
- [Portal Home](https://safesteps-kappa.vercel.app/): Main portal and symptom starter tools.
- [Emergency Help](https://safesteps-kappa.vercel.app/emergency): Immediate emergency numbers (112, 108, 14416) and first-aid instructions.
- [Symptom Chat](https://safesteps-kappa.vercel.app/chat): Care navigation consultation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://safesteps-kappa.vercel.app/privacy): Data protection and consent terms.
- [Terms of Service](https://safesteps-kappa.vercel.app/terms): Platform scope and medical governance.

## Medical Governance Notice
SafeSteps is strictly an educational triage assistant. It never provides definitive medical diagnoses, never prescribes medication doses, and never replaces a consultation with a qualified medical professional. In an emergency, dial 112 or 108 immediately.
